lineage.v2_alpha_source: the engine's candidate funnel (PROBE shortlist) sized by 1/sigma_63 (size-of-move / risk-parity weighting)

objective: terminal wealth under the declared personality (docs/OPTIMUS_OBJECTIVE.md §0), graded daily vs SPY and vs the frozen twin; the question is whether this alpha source's errors differ from the other five accounts'; no claim of skill

costs.fill_convention: DAY limit at ask x (1+10bps) for buys and bid x (1-10bps) for sells; an unfilled limit is not traded; last trade when the IEX quote is one-sided or wider than 2%

llm_authority: none: an LLM proposes; deterministic code sizes, stops and exits
owner_action_required: not before 2026-10-26 (roadmap §7: no new paper book before then)
archive first: python -m scripts.fleet_v3_prepare --archive (copies fleet_manager state/, decisions.jsonl, grades.jsonl, modes.json, contracts/ with a sha256 manifest; copies, never moves)
write a last broker-truth read: python -m scripts.fleet_manager_run --pass open --roles hack4 (no --live: DRY, reads and records only)
reset hack4 in the broker UI if wanted (paper reset = the owner's act)
teach scripts/fleet_manager_run.py a v3 path FIRST (today it resolves only v1/v2 and would silently fall back to v1 terms for 'v3')
activate = re-freeze this body into fleet_manager/contracts/ with status changed and the seed block filled; check fleet_v3_contracts.activation_diff(...)['same_rule']
set modes.json hack4 contract=v3, maintenance/entries DRY first, LIVE after one clean DRY pass
alpha_source: strategy-library rules that survive BOTH twins and the validation market line

selection.rule: eligible = status OK on BOTH boards AND pure_selection t >= 2 (full sample) on the basket fair twin AND on the sticky twin (TWIN_STICKY_v1) AND net_minus_market t >= 2 in the validation window (2009-2016, the 'validate' block). The book holds the eligible rules' current picks equally across rules; no eligible rule -> HOLD CASH, by rule, until a re-run board makes one eligible (a new board is read only at the monthly rebalance and its id is recorded on the decision)

exits: monthly rebalance to the eligible rules' picks; no eligible rule -> cash

stop_rule.sigma: 63-session sd of close-to-close returns on the bar-defect-screened panel (Alpaca daily bars when a name is not in the panel)
stop_rule.distance: clip(k_sigma x sigma, min_frac, max_frac) of the reference price
stop_rule.never_loosen: a replaced stop is never below the stop it replaces
stop_rule.order: GTC sell stop for the full long quantity; renewed within 7 days of its expiry
stop_rule.why: library rules are monthly; the stop is a disaster stop for them

twin.rule: each held rule is graded against its basket fair twin and its sticky twin (TWIN_STICKY_v1); while the book is cash, the twin is cash

worst_case.gap_note: a stop is not a floor: an overnight gap fills below it
worst_case.line: 10 x 10.00% x 12% stop = -$12,000 if every stop fills at its distance; 3-sigma day at 4.92% = -$14,763 (capped at 10% -> -$10,000 by scaling gross x0.68); sum|notional|/equity 1.00; no-stop ceiling -$100,000

kill_rule: account drawdown >= 20% -> flatten, DEPRIORITIZED; a rule whose re-run board drops it below the eligibility rule is sold at the next rebalance
